# Save Fixture Instructions

Place sanitized local save fixtures here only when they are safe to store in this private repository.

Recommended names:

- `clean_v2_65_3b.sav`
- `played_v2_65_3b_one_gym.sav`
- `randomized_moves_sample.sav`
- `randomized_abilities_sample.sav`

Do not include saves that expose personal/private data unless you are comfortable committing them. Party/PC parsing must remain disabled or low-confidence until clean/played fixture comparisons prove offsets, checksums, and Elite Redux-specific fields.
